label: Shifting slack between two stages
subgoals: Add delta to the setup slack of the stage into the shifted flop
Subtract delta from the setup slack of the stage out of it
Take the worse of the two as the result

label: The balancing shift
subgoals: Set the two shifted slacks equal
Solve for delta as half the difference of the slacks
Check that the balanced slack, the average of the two, is non-negative

label: The hold limit
subgoals: Read the hold slack of the stage into the shifted flop
Cap delta at that hold slack
Recompute the worse setup slack with the capped shift
